title: Hollow Ivory
text: A ribcage the size of a chapel, half sunk in the ground, each rib as thick as a tower. Whatever wore it died long before there were Houses to remember it. The bone is hollow, and something in the hollows hums, a deep, contented sound.

options.label: The deftest hands harvest the ivory.

outcomes.text: It comes away clean, and hums in the pack all the way home, a little louder when anyone sleeps.
It comes away, and so does something that was sleeping in it.
The humming stops as you leave, as if it had been listening. It starts again behind you, nearer, and keeps pace.
